outcome: Fix the curve-switch sensor-multiselect persistence bug in tabs/temperature_profile.py: widget keys are not qualified by curve_index, so selections made on one curve persist when switching to another, showing the wrong sensors on the plot.
success_metric: temperature_profile.py widget keys include st.session_state.current_curve_index; a new regression test pins this contract (RED on HEAD, GREEN after fix); all other tests continue passing
constraints: TDD: failing test first; narrow scope only - do not touch other tabs unless they have the same bug
out_of_scope: Other tabs' widget keys (audit separately if similar bug exists)
Streamlit AppTest framework integration (project has no existing infra for it)
stop_criteria: Regression test green AND key format inspectable via inspect.getsource
handoff_artifacts: Updated tabs/temperature_profile.py with per-curve widget keys
New tests/test_widget_key_per_curve.py (or similar) pinning the contract
